sentences.text:
Through: Mr. O. P. Thakur, Sr. Advocate with
 Mr. O. S. Bandral, Advocate.
 Vs
Ut of J&K and Ors. ..... Respondent(s)

Through: Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. Aag for R-1 to 5.
 Mr. Vishal Sharma, Dsgi for R-6.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

16.09.2023 01. 28 petitioners have joined together as being aggrieved land owners with respect to land acquisition exercise which culminated in passing of a final acquisition award no.
SDM/JN/LA/2020-21/47-52 dated 26.12.2020 passed by the respondent no. 5 - the Collector Land Acquisition (SDM), Jammu-North in terms whereof land measuring 535.02 kanals falling in villages, namely, Ghaink and Amb, tehsil Bhalwal has been purportedly acquired for the public purpose of establishment of KLP of BSF Battalion, Jammu Frontier.

02. The passing of the acquisition award aforementioned land is sourced to a Notification no.
SDM/JN/LA/2019-20/89-96 dated 28.06.2019 issued under section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act,
Svt., 1990 by the respondent no. 5 - the Collector Land Acquisition (SDM), Jammu-North in response to an Indent no. 2001/11/land/Ftr(J)KLP/Rjr/2018/2061-67 dated 05.07.2018 placed by the Inspector General, Hq. Jammu FTR, BSF.
03.

The petitioners are aggrieved that with the intervention of Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019 and by virtue of S.O. 3912 (E) dated 30.10.2019, the land acquisition exercise originating Kuldeep Singh And Ors vs Ut Of J&K And Ors on 16 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156567028/
1 under J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 but not completed ought to have been switched over to acquisition under the Right to Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 which in result would have earned higher rate of compensation in favour of the land owners sought to be expropriated but the respondents have acted illegally by carrying through the acquisition under the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 which is at the cost of wrongful loss to the petitioners and, therefore, vitiate the land acquisition exercise.
04. Prima facie case is made out.

sentences.text: Mrs. Monika Kohli, the learned Senior AAG accepts notice on behalf of respondents no. 1 to 5 and Mr. Vishal Sharma, the learned DSGI accepts notice on behalf of respondent no. 6.
Reply/objections be filed by or before the next date of hearing.
In the meantime, status quo with respect to petitioners' land forming subject matter of the impugned acquisition shall be maintained obtaining as on date.
09. This direction is, however, subject to objections from the other side.
(Rahul Bharti) Judge Jammu 16.09.2023 Bunty Kuldeep Singh And Ors vs Ut Of J&K And Ors on 16 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156567028/
